_comment: Adapter patch expectations, keyed by canonical source revision. The adapter must work against BOTH the legacy CDN artifact live today and the canonical source once published, so expected counts differ per profile. expected=0 means a deliberate no-op: a dual-variant fallback, a form the bundle already contains, or behaviour folded into the canonical source.
_profile_selection: A bundle declaring `var MMED_SCHEDULER_SOURCE_REV = "<rev>"` uses the profile of that name. A bundle with no marker is the pre-MX-APPT-5002 artifact and uses `legacy`.
